tasks.listening-speaking-t3: Generate Grade 6 isiXhosa SAL multiple-choice questions on listening and speaking for Term 3. Focus on weather, transport, animals, culture, folktales, listening sequence tasks, and giving simple supported opinions. Use short classroom scenarios and oral-response style prompts.
tasks.reading-viewing-t3: Generate Grade 6 isiXhosa SAL multiple-choice questions on reading and viewing for Term 3. Focus on folktales, posters, short factual texts, poems, visual cues, and retrieval skills like who, where, and what happened. Use short passages and text-image matching contexts.
tasks.writing-presenting-t3: Generate Grade 6 isiXhosa SAL multiple-choice questions on writing and presenting for Term 3. Focus on invitations, directions, short recounts, picture paragraphs, and cultural themes. Include format checks, sentence sequencing, and choosing details that fit purpose and audience.
tasks.language-structures-t3: Generate Grade 6 isiXhosa SAL multiple-choice questions on language structures and conventions for Term 3. Focus on future tense, conjunctions, noun classes, connectors, and question words. Include tense change items, sentence linking, and grammar correction in simple contexts.
